paragraphs: Rabbi Yehoshua of Sikhnin—he is buried there, Gelilot Eretz Yisrael [גא״י; provisional expansion]—and Rabbi Abba son of Rav Pappi, in Rabbi Levi’s name; see his entry. In Rabbi Yehoshua ben Levi’s name: Eichah Rabbah, on ‘The city great in people.’ And Rabbi Acha bar Shalki and Rabbi Chanina bar Shalki in Rabbi Simon’s name and in Rabbi Yochanan’s name. And Rabbi Yehudah ben Neron; Rabbi Mana of Shaav. Rabbi Pappi transmitted in his name. And Rabbi Chiyya bar Pappi.
